interpretive_boundaries: The figure is an author synthesis of repository contracts and local engineering evidence; it reports no identity accuracy, coverage, time saving, user outcome or production result.
Structural Companies House-number validation and a named local review do not establish that a live registry record exists, is current, is complete or proves economic activity.
Names only order candidates; domains and documents remain separately reviewable supporting claims. None authorises fuzzy, name-only, domain-only or document-only automatic legal-entity merging.
The public-web research route has fake, synthetic and adversarial engineering evidence but no completed live company or external-model run is claimed.
Direct Companies House retrieval remains G2 held. Synthetic replay validates mechanisms but is not live-source admission.

The concurrently changing company_research.py, its full-workflow test and test_control_room_api.py are not hash-bound inputs to the 27-input stable identity-control seal. Their selected fake/synthetic checks pass as separately recorded supplementary engineering evidence, not live-source, empirical or production evidence.

Local database uniqueness, create-once files and stale-decision rejection reduce duplicate or conflicting writes; they do not provide distributed transactions, production concurrency, multi-user tenancy or authoritative deduplication.
